A '''Winter Sack''' is a [[Sack]] that holds {{Green|20,160x}} of [[Jerry's Workshop]] related items. 

== Obtaining ==
=== Sherry ===
A '''Winter Sack''' can be bought from {{NPCSprite|Sherry}} on [[Jerry's Workshop]] for {{c|250k}}.

=== Gift ===
A '''Winter Sack''' can be obtained by opening {{Item|Red Gift}}s. There is a {{Chance|1.81%|1|55.38|gifts}} chance of receiving a '''Winter Sack''' from {{Item|Red Gift}}s.

== Usage ==
The '''Winter Sack''' can store items obtained on {{Zone|Jerry's Workshop}}.
